title: Lighthouse rollout checklist, short-window calendar, and release-notes draft
body:
Purpose:
Lightweight, shareable checklist + 3-day short-window calendar for the ‘Lighthouse’ rollout. This is a focused checklist for teams that want a compact canary with a fast decision loop (3h per wave). Not a full cutover playbook — use alongside staging-to-prod-handover doc and SRE on-call runbook.

High-level goal:
- Validate: low-risk feature gating and model variant routing for Hosted API.
- Safety: ensure graceful fallback to baseline model variants and Dedicated capacity fallback during surge.
- Speed: 3-hour waves so product can decide quickly on roll forward/rollback.

Assumptions / pre-reqs (must be green before starting):
- Staging smoke passed in last 24h (smoke-id: smoke-2026-03-02-17).
- Canary images baked and tagged: platform:v2026.05-lh1.
- Model artifact pins: model-x v1.3.1-quant / model-x v1.3.0 (fallback).
- Capacity: Dedicated pool reserved for rollout (pool id: pool-dedicated-42).
- Observability: per-route tracing toggled on; dashboards copied to release view.
- Pager roster confirmed and notified (oncall list pinned in #releases).

Quick Decision Matrix (3h wave):
- Green: error rate <= baseline + 0.1% AND 95th latency <= baseline * 1.25 -> roll forward to next wave.
- Caution: error rate between baseline +0.1% and baseline +0.5% OR 95th latency between baseline*1.25 and baseline*1.5 -> pause and investigate (30–60 min).
- Rollback: error rate > baseline +0.5% OR 95th latency > baseline*1.5 or systemic model-quality regressions (QA eval fail) -> rollback immediately.

Wave schedule (UTC):
- Wave 0 (canary warm-up): 2026-05-18 06:00–07:00 UTC -> 1% traffic, internal-only, smoke checks run at :15, :45
- Wave 1: 2026-05-18 07:00–10:00 UTC -> 5% traffic, 3h window
- Wave 2: 2026-05-18 10:00–13:00 UTC -> 20% traffic, 3h window
- Wave 3: 2026-05-18 13:00–16:00 UTC -> 50% traffic, 3h window
- Wave 4 (full cut): 2026-05-18 16:00–18:00 UTC -> 100% or manual approval for gradual increase

Owner matrix (primary contact first):
- Release lead: Maya Thompson (release-owner)
- Serving runtime lead: Ethan Cole (runtime)
- Observability / SLI: Sofia Martinez (telemetry)
- Platform infra (K8s / autoscale): Ravi Patel (infra)
- Product/QA liaison: Hannah Lee (qa)
- Oncall SRE backup: Aisha N’Dour (sre)

Preflight checklist (run in order, sign-off required):
1) Branch-level artifacts: confirm PRs merged and image tags: tools/ci/check-image-tags.sh -> exit 0. Owner: Maya.
2) Schema / contract check: api-contracts/validate.sh against production schema. Owner: Hannah.
3) Model pin verification: models/verify-pins.py --env=prod --expected=model-x@v1.3.1-quant. Owner: Ethan.
4) KV cache warm-up strategy: confirm prefix caching is enabled for common prompts. Owner: Ravi.
5) Canary config applied: infra/apply-canary-config --wave=0. Owner: Ravi.
6) Telemetry baseline exported: dashboards/export-baseline.sh --route=chat.generate. Owner: Sofia.
7) Smoke test run: scripts/smoke-chatflow.sh --samples=200; results uploaded to linked_artifacts. Owner: Hannah.
8) Communication: create #release-lighthouse thread and post wave start times + runbook link. Owner: Maya.

Run commands (quick reference):
- Promote to next wave: infra/promote-canary --from=wave-1 --to=wave-2 --confirm-by=${release-owner}
- Immediate rollback: infra/rollback-release --tag=previous-stable --force --reason="auto/metric-trigger"
- Throttle inbound: platform/rate-limit --route=chat.generate --qps=50 --note="Lighthouse pause"
- Re-route to Dedicated fallback: routing/set-policy --route=chat.generate --policy=fallback-dedicated

Telemetry + Alerts to watch (owner):
- request_error_rate_1m (SLO delta) (Sofia) -> alert if > baseline +0.3% for 5m
- p95_latency_route_chat.generate (Sofia) -> alert if > baseline*1.4 for 5m
- gpu_mem_pressure_node_group (Ravi) -> alert if > 80% for sustained 2m
- kv_cache_hit_rate (Ethan) -> alert if hit-rate drops > 10% vs baseline

Known-edge checks (hand-test matrix):
- Long-context sessions: run long-context smoke ( > 8k tokens ) against canary and baseline and diff latency tails. Owner: Ethan.
- Function-calls / tooling: verify tool-call metadata preserved through streaming path. Owner: Hannah.
- Quantized model parity: quick-lint of top-10 prompts to detect hallucination/regression. Owner: Sofia.

Rollback plan (fast):
- Criteria: any single 5-min window breaching rollback thresholds OR QA eval fail on production sample set.
- Steps: 1) Run infra/rollback-release --tag=stable-2026-05-17 2) Re-route traffic to fallback model 3) Pin Dedicated pool temporarily at 120% capacity 4) Open incident channel with SRE and product
- Post-mortem: start template at confluence/pm-templates/short-pm and invite infra + runtime + product

Release notes (draft) — to be expanded by Product marketing: 
Title: Lighthouse rollout: model-x v1.3.1-quant + runtime micro-optimizations
Summary: Small, targeted rollout to improve token throughput for longer contexts and reduce tail latency for chat.generate. Includes model quantization profile changes and runtime kernel selection improvements.
Changes (high level):
- Model: model-x v1.3.1-quant — faster int8 execution with minor tokenization alignment fixes.
- Serving runtime: improved KV cache eviction logic to reduce repeated recompute on hot prefixes.
- Routing: added canary-aware routing policy and Dedicated-fallback binding.

User-facing notes / known issues:
- If you rely on exact token-level deterministic outputs for model-x, expect low-probability minor token offsets for edge prompts (documented). We recommend pinning to model-x v1.3.0 for strict determinism.
- Some customers on older client SDKs may see stream reconnection behavior; upgrade SDK >= v0.9.4 recommended.

Decision log + unresolved items (TODOs):
- Confirm escalation window for FYI vs action for customers in premium SLAs (action: Maya to confirm with sales).
- Finalize dedicated pool sizing for post-rollout surge (action: Ravi to run load-proj and provide numbers by 2026-03-14).
- Decide whether to include the backend kernel change in release notes or a separate runtime patch note (action: Ethan).

Post-roll tasks (within 24h after full cut):
- Run regression eval suite on production sampling set and upload results. Owner: Sofia.
- Archive canary logs and mark canary run-id in release tracker. Owner: Maya.
- Follow-up incident review if any alerts fired during rollout. Owner: Ravi.

Appendix / Useful links:
- Staging-to-prod handoff checklist: confluence/staging-handoff-2026
- Runbook: runbooks/cutover-lighthouse.md
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2487
- Jira epic: JIRA-RELEASE-889

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep waves short; product wants <6 hours decision time.
- If p95 looks flakey but error rate stable, consider increasing sampling for long-context tests before rollback.
- Keep a small set of golden prompts pinned for quick verbal QA during waves.

-- end of draft --
